messages:
emily: Deploybot just surfaced a p95 latency + error bump on the canary after the 5.2.0 push (eu-west). p95 ~720ms (target 300ms), errors ~2.8% (baseline 0.5%). canary slice = 7%. auto-rollback policy is gated by the noon change window. need quick decision: manual rollback for canary, pin, or hotfix rollforward?
karim: can we get a quick diff on runtime changes in 5.2.0? last change was a kernel switch + batching tweak. if kernel is culprit, hotfix might be risky.
sophia: i pulled the release diff: "kernel: opt-vec4 -> opt-avx; batching: default 8->12". suspect batch bump increasing tail latency.
deploybot: [ALERT] canary_p95_error_rate (alert id cb-9123). metrics snapshot: p95=720ms, error_rate=2.8%, traffic=7%. Auto-revert suppressed by change-window policy.
emily: blast radius? any dedicated customers on canary?
qa-bot: route membership: dev-sandboxes + 2 internal test tenants. no enterprise SLA routes.
karim: low blast. i'd prefer pin+rollback of the canary slice to stable (5.1.9) while we fix batching heuristics. safer than trying a risky hotfix.
sophia: agree. pin the route first to avoid more users hitting bad variant, then rollback canary. we'll keep the remaining traffic on 5.2.0 so rollout continues.
luke-cs: if you pin/rollback, i'll draft a quick CS blurb and a short email to dev tenants. need start/end timestamps.
emily: action list: 1) pin canary route to v5.1.9, 2) run rollback script for canary only, 3) reduce batch size globally for canary traffic if needed, 4) post release-note entry and CS blurb. who takes exec?
karim: i'll run the pin. command: `redwood route pin --route=canary --version=v5.1.9 --actor=karim`
deploybot: [ACTION] Route pin executed by karim at 4933334452. pinned -> v5.1.9.
karim: now starting rollback: `./rollback-script --region=eu-west --slice=canary --to=v5.1.9` (exec start 11:07 UTC)
deploybot: [ACTION] Rollback started by karim at 4933334460. progress: 20% -> 55% -> 100%. logs: "drain connections -> swap model -> warm caches -> switch traffic"
karim: rollback finished. p95 back to ~280ms; errors down to 0.6%. monitoring 10m watch.
qa-bot: quick smoke: 100 sample requests returned expected outputs; no function-call regressions seen.
luke-cs: drafting: "We observed elevated latency and errors on a small canary slice after 5.2.0 deploy. We pinned and rolled back the canary to 5.1.9 while we investigate batching and kernel interactions. No customer data impacted. Monitoring continues; follow-up postmortem to come." will post after you confirm times.
sophia: confirm timestamps: pin at 4933334452, rollback start 4933334460, rollback complete 4933334468. tag release-notes commit with #rollback-4933334444.
emily: done. also open ENG-PR-5123 to evaluate batch-size heuristics and kernel selection guardrails. assign to eng-runtime.
karim: created ticket ENG-PR-5123 and linked to release notes.
deploybot: Monitoring: 10m p95 stable at 270-300ms; error rate back to baseline. closing window if green for 20m.
luke-cs: customer note posted to #customer-ops and email to dev tenants sent (included times + link to status).
emily: thanks everyone. follow-up: eng-runtime to run vulnerability test for kernel path and add canary gating for batch size >10. closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
